from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.home() / ".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
TASK_ID = "A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-20261006-R2"
UNIT = "prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-20261006-R2.service"
RESULT = ROOT / "model_results" / f"{TASK_ID}.json"
DB = ROOT / "models" / "runtime.sqlite"

if RESULT.is_file() and not RESULT.is_symlink():
    print("R2_CLASS=RESULT_PRESENT RESULT_EXISTS=1")
    raise SystemExit(0)

status = "NO_TASK_ROW"
attempt = 0
seq = 0
reason = "NO_TRANSITION"
retry = 0.0
stamp = 0.0

if DB.is_file() and not DB.is_symlink():
    db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        row = db.execute(
            "select status,attempt from tasks where id=?",
            (TASK_ID,),
        ).fetchone()
        tr = db.execute(
            "select seq,state,reason,attempt,stamp,retry from transitions "
            "where task=? order by seq desc limit 1",
            (TASK_ID,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        db.close()
    if row:
        status = str(row[0])
        attempt = int(row[1] or 0)
    if tr:
        seq = int(tr[0] or 0)
        reason = str(tr[2] or "NO_REASON")
        attempt = int(tr[3] or attempt or 0)
        stamp = float(tr[4] or 0)
        retry = float(tr[5] or 0)

effective_retry = min(retry, stamp + 900) if reason == "USAGE_LIMIT" else retry
retry_remaining = max(0, int(effective_retry - time.time())) if effective_retry else 0

service = {}
cp = subprocess.run(
    ["systemctl", "--user", "show", UNIT,
     "-p", "ActiveState",
     "-p", "SubState",
     "-p", "Result",
     "-p", "ExecMainStatus",
     "-p", "ExecMainCode"],
    text=True,
    capture_output=True,
    timeout=20,
    check=False,
)
for line in cp.stdout.splitlines():
    if "=" in line:
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        service[k] = v

if status == "PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT":
    classification = "PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT"
elif status == "WAITING_RETRY":
    classification = "WAITING_RETRY"
elif status == "RUNNING":
    classification = "RUNNING"
elif status == "COMPLETE":
    classification = "COMPLETE_WITHOUT_RESULT"
elif status in {"FAILED", "BLOCKED"}:
    classification = "RUNTIME_FAILURE"
elif status == "QUEUED":
    classification = "QUEUED"
elif status == "NO_TASK_ROW":
    classification = "TASK_NOT_ENQUEUED"
else:
    classification = "UNEXPECTED_STATUS"

print(
    "R2_CLASS=" + classification
    + " RESULT_EXISTS=0"
    + " TASK_STATUS=" + status
    + " ATTEMPT=" + str(attempt)
    + " SEQ=" + str(seq)
    + " REASON=" + reason.replace(" ", "_")[:160]
    + " RETRY_REMAINING=" + str(retry_remaining)
    + " ACTIVE=" + service.get("ActiveState", "UNKNOWN")
    + " SUB=" + service.get("SubState", "UNKNOWN")
    + " SYSTEMD_RESULT=" + service.get("Result", "UNKNOWN")
    + " EXEC_MAIN_STATUS=" + service.get("ExecMainStatus", "UNKNOWN")
)
raise SystemExit(10)
